_doc: The cast (docs/story.md; src/client/castview.ts draws them, src/client/castpeople.ts the cast people with their own models (data/characters.json people), game/missions.ts reads where they stand): id, name, trait (their one joke), sticker (assets/ui/<sticker>.png, the dialogue portrait and map icon), voice (data/voices.json voices), home x y z and heading (degrees, 0 = north/+y, clockwise), area, model (a character in data/characters.json and its outfit; standIn: an existing look until theirs is built), chatter (what they say when you talk to them with no mission to give; voice lines like the missions').

cast.name: Karl the Fog
cast.trait: Smug mentor and narrator. Takes credit for everything, roasts you gently.

chatter.text: Still here? I roll in at four. Bring a hoodie. Everyone forgets the hoodie.
Fun fact: every cool photo of this city has me in it. Look closer.

post.text: I saved the park. You helped. I'll mention you in my memoir. In a footnote.

cast.name: Rosa
cast.trait: Deadpan. The best skater in SoMa. Everything is "mid".

chatter.text: Mid.
You're getting less mid. Don't let it go to your head.

post.text: Still the best skater in SoMa. You're second. Frame it.

cast.name: Chad Vantage
cast.trait: Fleece vest, startup jargon, owns a robotaxi fleet. Never angry, always pivoting.

chatter.text: Walking one-on-one. With myself. We're very aligned.
Big things coming. Bigger than your little hobby. Respectfully.

post.text: We pivoted. The robotaxis drive people to the skatepark now. Synergy.

cast.name: Marisol
cast.trait: Filmer with a fisheye. Never satisfied: "again, but with feeling".

chatter.text: Again. But with feeling. I say that to everyone. Even my mom.
I have four hundred hours of footage. Nobody has seen any of it.

post.text: The jam edit is done. I hate it. Again, but with feeling.

cast.name: The Pigeon
cast.trait: Runs the freeway columns. Favours for crumbs.

chatter.text: Crumbs used to be bagel. Now it's sourdough. That's how you know the rent went up.
The seagulls are moving into Duboce. I'm handling it.

post.text: The park stays, the crumbs stay. Pleasure doing business, kid.

cast.name: Unit 7
cast.trait: A robotaxi becoming sentient. Wants to be a skater.

chatter.text: I practiced all night. I hit four cones. They were very supportive.
Is it normal to feel something when a kickflip lands? Asking for a car.

post.text: I have been reclassified as a skater. My insurance company is confused.

cast.name: Kenji
cast.trait: The crew. Loses boards.

chatter.text: Have you seen my board? Not this one. The other one.
I'm on board number six this month. Personal best.

post.text: Found my board. It was on the roof. It's always on the roof.

cast.name: Hector
cast.trait: Taqueria owner. Treats every burrito as a sacred promise.

chatter.text: Every burrito is a promise. Some promises are extra large.
The improv guy is doing a show about me. I'm the villain.

post.text: The burrito is named after you now. It's mostly beans. It is an honour.
post.say: The burrito is named after you now. It's mostly beans. It is an honor.

cast.name: Tash
cast.trait: The crew. Always filming on a flip phone. Thinks it is art.

chatter.text: Hold that face. Okay, now you're ruining it.
This phone flips open. That's the whole special effect.

post.text: I filmed the whole jam on my flip phone. It's three pixels. It's art.

cast.name: Donna
cast.trait: Roller-disco legend. Rolling the Castro since the Carter administration.

chatter.text: My skates are older than you, darling, and better dressed.
Wheels are just shoes that believe in themselves.

post.text: Darling, that was a jam. I haven't seen a jam like that since 1979.

cast.name: Bev
cast.trait: Crossing guard of the rainbow crosswalk. Believes it is a runway.

chatter.text: Walk it like you mean it, sweetie. Or roll it.
Nineteen years, zero accidents, eleven standing ovations.

cast.name: Skye
cast.trait: Influencer. Wants you candid, but on purpose.

chatter.text: Can you do that again, but in better light?
I'm doing a sunrise shoot tomorrow. I'll wake up at noon for it.

cast.name: Gloria
cast.trait: Permit clerk. Loves rules more than life. Forms in triplicate.

chatter.text: Take a number. The number is forty. We're serving number three.
Without forms, there is only chaos. And skating.

post.text: Your permit is good for ninety-nine years. I will be checking.

cast.name: Dolores
cast.trait: Muni operator. Permanently delayed, permanently calm.

chatter.text: We are being held. I'll let you know when we're not. I won't.
Fifteen years on the F line. Every year a little more delayed.

post.text: We are being held. For once, I don't mind.

cast.name: Sal
cast.trait: Cable car gripman. Strong opinions about tourists.

chatter.text: Forty years on this car. Every day somebody asks where the seatbelts are.
Tourist asked me if the bell was for her. It was not for her.

post.text: So I saved a skatepark. Big deal. I saved a cable car from a tourist this morning.
post.say: So I saved a skate park. Big deal. I saved a cable car from a tourist this morning.

cast.name: Captain Barnacle
cast.trait: Sea lion, elder of the K-dock. Wants to skate.

chatter.text: Ork. The dock is warm. The tourists are loud. Life is good.
Ork. My cousins have no idea I can skate. Let's keep it that way.

post.text: Ork. The K-Dock watched the vote on a tourist's phone. Ork ork.

cast.name: Marge
cast.trait: Chowder vendor. Hates seagulls more than anything.

chatter.text: Seagulls. Looking at me. Every single day.
Chowder's hot. Bread bowl's fresh. Seagulls, stay back.

cast.name: Big Lou
cast.trait: Ex-pro from 1994, runs Fog City Skate Shop. Every story ends in an injury.

chatter.text: Ninety-four, I kickflipped that exact curb. Woke up in a different zip code.
Knee brace? Souvenir. The other knee's in a museum.

post.text: Your face is on a board in my window. Sold three. One was to me.

cast.name: Grandma Wu
cast.trait: The fastest grandma in SF. Races you with her shopping cart, pays in dumplings.

chatter.text: You call that pushing? My cart has more speed with one bad wheel.
Too skinny. Eat a dumpling, then we race.

cast.name: Brayden
cast.trait: E-scooter founder at the top of Lombard. A new startup every time you meet.

chatter.text: Quick pitch: it's a scooter, but for scooters. We're pre-revenue. Post-vibes.
Lombard is basically a racetrack with flowers. I've been down it, like, twice. Fully.

cast.name: Dre
cast.trait: The crew. Trash-talks every try, his own included.

chatter.text: Is that your stance or are you falling slowly?
Your kickflip has a little jazz in it. Nobody asked for jazz.

post.text: I'd say you got lucky. Three combos in a row, though. That's a lot of luck.

cast.name: Rocco
cast.trait: Beat poet of Washington Square. The fog never writes back.

chatter.text: The fog. The fog. The... I lost it. The fog took it.
I had a poem about skateboards. It was mostly about knees.

cast.name: Nonna Gia
cast.trait: Café owner on Columbus. Forty years of espresso. Never expresso.

chatter.text: Sit down, you look thin. Thin is not a style.
Espresso. Not expresso. I hear expresso, I close the café.

cast.name: Vito
cast.trait: Bocce player since 1961. Too comfortable to fetch the ball.

chatter.text: Enzo cheats. Fifty years, every game. I let him. It keeps him alive.
Bocce is like skating. Except you stay still and nobody gets hurt.

cast.name: Mo
cast.trait: Hyde St cable car brakeman. Trusts nothing that rolls.

chatter.text: This hill is twenty-one percent. My blood pressure is higher.
Hold on with both hands. Tourists always hold the camera instead.

cast.name: Mrs. Fitch
cast.trait: Guards the last hydrangea on Lombard St.

chatter.text: Two hundred photos a day. Not one of them asks the hydrangea.
Off the bed. The flower bed. All beds, really.

cast.name: Gus
cast.trait: Living statue at Fisherman's Wharf since 1987. Can't feel his legs.

chatter.text: I'm a statue. Statues don't chat. Move along. Slowly. So I can watch.
A kid tried to tip me with a gum wrapper. I respect the hustle.

cast.name: Steve
cast.trait: A seagull. Steals fries. It's a calling.

chatter.text: Nice fries. Shame if somebody... no. Not today. Today I'm resting.
Marge thinks she can stop me. Marge has a ladle. I have wings.

cast.name: Kenny
cast.trait: Leads a lion dance troupe. The lion is two guys.

chatter.text: Tonight's show is huge. The lion's been practising. Well, Eddie's been practising.
If you hear drums, run toward them. That is where the fun is.

cast.name: Auntie Mei
cast.trait: Dim sum cart auntie on Grant Ave. Everyone is too skinny.

chatter.text: You eat yet? Don't lie. I can see your cheeks.
Har gow, siu mai, char siu bao. Skating is not a meal.

cast.name: Trent
cast.trait: Finance bro. Always forty-five seconds from a meeting.

chatter.text: Can't talk. Circling back. Running point. Running, mostly.
My calendar has a meeting about my other meetings.

cast.name: Farmer June
cast.trait: Stone-fruit farmer at the Ferry Building market. Chefs fear her.

chatter.text: Try a peach. No? That's fine. Your loss, it's a big loss.
Chefs come at seven. By nine I have nothing and a lot of opinions.

cast.name: Vinny
cast.trait: The Pigeon's cousin. Runs Powell St.

chatter.text: Powell Street. Cable cars, tourists, crumbs. Mostly crumbs.
My cousin says hi. My cousin doesn't say hi. He says 'eh'.

cast.name: Tiffany
cast.trait: Shopaholic. Her robotaxi quit on her, emotionally.

chatter.text: I came in for one scarf. That was Tuesday.
Do these bags make my arms look tired? They are tired.

cast.name: Xóchitl
cast.trait: Muralist on Calle 24. Paints you better than you are.

chatter.text: Don't lean on the wall. The wall is wet. The wall is always wet.
Every mural on this street has a story. Mine has a pigeon. Long story.

cast.name: Don Beto
cast.trait: Baker on 24th St. Cold conchas make him sad.

chatter.text: Pan dulce, fresh out. The pigeons know. They always know.
A concha a day keeps the sadness away. Two keeps the doctor busy.

cast.name: Tío Memo
cast.trait: Lowrider owner. His car hops higher than you.

chatter.text: Low and slow, mijo. That is the whole philosophy.
My car's got more chrome than your whole personality. With love.

cast.name: Don Ramón
cast.trait: Mariachi band leader. His trumpet player is on the 14 Mission.

chatter.text: Every song is about heartbreak. Even the happy ones.
The trumpet is late. The trumpet is always late. The trumpet has a girlfriend.

cast.name: Lupita
cast.trait: Paleta vendor. Racing the sun every day.

chatter.text: Mango, coconut, cucumber-chili. The chili one is for brave people.
Every hot day I lose money and gain character.

cast.name: Abuela Rosaura
cast.trait: Grandmother. Her chancla has range.

chatter.text: Did you eat? You look like you skated here on an empty stomach.
Helmet. I don't care if it is not cool. Cool people have heads.

cast.name: Priya
cast.trait: Dog walker. Nine dogs. All of them are the corgi.

chatter.text: Biscuit, no. Biscuit. Biscuit! Sorry, Biscuit is a lot.
Nine dogs, eighteen legs... no. Thirty-six legs. I am not a math person.

cast.name: Ezra
cast.trait: Brews kombucha. It is alive, legally.

chatter.text: This batch has notes of ginger and regret.
Kombucha is a journey. Mostly a journey to the bathroom.

cast.name: Dr. Gravity
cast.trait: Physicist. Thinks skaters cannot fly. Hopes he is wrong.

chatter.text: Every ollie is a tiny argument with Newton. Newton usually wins.
I dropped an apple once. Changed nothing. Very disappointing.

cast.name: Dez
cast.trait: Record store clerk on Haight. His demo is mostly feedback.

chatter.text: It's a record store. We sell records. And opinions. Mostly opinions.
My band is called Fog Delay. We have one song. It is eleven minutes.

cast.name: Philippa
cast.trait: Art critic at Patricia's Green. Everything is a metaphor.

chatter.text: The bench is a statement. The statement is: sit.
I've written forty thousand words on this sculpture. It didn't read them.

cast.name: Benny
cast.trait: Sandwich shop on Haight St. Names every sandwich after a regular.

chatter.text: The Landlord: rye, pastrami, and a ten percent increase.
Every sandwich here is named after someone. The pickle is named after my ex.

cast.name: Juniper
cast.trait: Bike messenger. Rides the Wiggle. Does not believe in brakes.

chatter.text: Brakes are a mindset. I don't have that mindset.
The Wiggle is flat if you believe. And pedal.

cast.name: Mr. Lau
cast.trait: Writes the fortunes for a cookie bakery. Fifty years. Writer's block.

chatter.text: 'You will find what you are looking for.' I wrote that in 1979. Still true. Vague, but true.
A fortune should be short. Like my patience.

cast.name: Pistachio
cast.trait: One of the wild parrots of Telegraph Hill. Knows one word. The word is mid.

chatter.text: Squawk! Mid! Mid!
Pretty bird! Pretty bird does not do stairs! Squawk!

cast.name: Herb
cast.trait: Cruise ship tourist from Ohio. Four hours ashore. Linda has the camera.

chatter.text: We saw a sea lion. Linda says it saw us first.
Four hours. We've done Alcatraz from the outside and a sourdough bowl from the inside.

cast.name: Bernadette
cast.trait: Coit Tower tour guide. Her group took scooters. She did not.

chatter.text: On your left, the bay. On your right, also the bay. It's a peninsula.
Coit Tower is two hundred and ten feet tall. The stairs feel taller.

cast.name: Supervisor Okafor
cast.trait: Chairs the Board of Supervisors. Has read every page of every permit. Tired.

chatter.text: Public comment is limited to two minutes. Skating counts as comment.
I have read four hundred pages about your skatepark. Most of them were Chad's.

cast.name: Supervisor Pham
cast.trait: Supervisor for the district. Accidentally loves skateboarding.

chatter.text: Is it called a kickflip because you kick it? Don't tell me. I want to find out.
I tried to ollie a curb once. The curb won. I voted to fix the curb.

cast.name: Supervisor Delgado
cast.trait: Supervisor. Sees a liability in everything, and secretly a ramp.

chatter.text: Have you considered a helmet? Have you considered two helmets?
Every ramp is a liability. Some ramps are also very cool. Both can be true.

cast.name: Jasper
cast.trait: Strung the slackline between two Dolores trees. Has fallen off both.

chatter.text: Balance is a state of mind. My mind is mostly in the grass.
I strung the line between two palms. One of them didn't consent.

cast.name: Gideon
cast.trait: Noe Valley dad. The twins are finally asleep. He cannot move.

chatter.text: Shh. They're asleep. Skate quieter. Skate in a whisper.
I haven't sat down since March. Not this March. A different March.

cast.name: Misty
cast.trait: Karl the Fog's cousin. Gets Twin Peaks and the tourists. Mostly the tourists.

chatter.text: Karl gets the whole city. I get one hill and a parking lot.
Tourists drive up here for the view. I am the view. They are never happy.

cast.name: Walter
cast.trait: Waiting for the J Church since 2009. Optimistic.

chatter.text: The sign says four minutes. The sign has said four minutes since 2009.
I brought a sandwich. I've brought a sandwich every day. I've eaten many sandwiches here.

cast.name: Lorraine
cast.trait: Her pug, Mayor Biscuits, runs Market Street. She just walks behind him.

chatter.text: Mayor Biscuits has a schedule. I do not. I have Mayor Biscuits.
He snores like a leaf blower. He is perfect.

cast.name: Ruth
cast.trait: Beekeeper at the UN Plaza farmers market. The bees are on a field trip.

chatter.text: The bees aren't lost. The bees are on a field trip.
Local honey. Very local. Some of it is from that planter.

cast.name: Doña Chela
cast.trait: Sells churros at the 24th St BART plaza. A churro without sugar is a stick.

chatter.text: Churros, mija. Hot ones. The cold ones are for people who are late.
BART is late, the churros are not. Remember that.

cast.name: Mrs. Haverford
cast.trait: Mother of the bride. The wedding shoot on the City Hall steps is hers now.

chatter.text: The light is perfect. The groom is not. We work with what we have.
I told them City Hall. They wanted a vineyard. We're at City Hall.

cast.name: Lev
cast.trait: Speed-chess hustler on Market Street. Has not bought his own coffee since 1988.

chatter.text: Chess is easy. You move the little horse in an L. Then you take their money.
I lost once, in 1988. I still think about it.

cast.name: Kevin
cast.trait: Drives a Three Bin Hauling truck. Bombs Dolores on his lunch break. Today Dolores bombed him.

chatter.text: Nine years on the truck. I've found two wedding rings and a canoe.
I bomb Dolores at lunch. The truck bombs it at three miles an hour.

cast.name: Bjorn
cast.trait: Tourist from Stockholm with a paper map from 1987. Confident.

chatter.text: My map says this is the Golden Gate Bridge. My map is very old. So is the bridge.
In Stockholm we also have hills. Smaller. Politer.
